title: Google\Cloud\Compute\V1\RouterNatSubnetworkToNat
name: RouterNatSubnetworkToNat
description: Defines the IP ranges that want to use NAT for a subnetwork.

params.name: data
params.description: Optional. Data for populating the Message object.

params.name: data.name
params.description: URL for the subnetwork resource that will use NAT.

params.name: data.secondary_ip_range_names
params.description: A list of the secondary ranges of the Subnetwork that are allowed to use NAT. This can be populated only if "LIST_OF_SECONDARY_IP_RANGES" is one of the values in source_ip_ranges_to_nat.

params.name: data.source_ip_ranges_to_nat
params.description: Specify the options for NAT ranges in the Subnetwork. All options of a single value are valid except NAT_IP_RANGE_OPTION_UNSPECIFIED. The only valid option with multiple values is: ["PRIMARY_IP_RANGE", "LIST_OF_SECONDARY_IP_RANGES"] Default: [ALL_IP_RANGES]

methods.name: getName
methods.description: URL for the subnetwork resource that will use NAT.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: URL for the subnetwork resource that will use NAT.

methods.name: getSecondaryIpRangeNames
methods.description: A list of the secondary ranges of the Subnetwork that are allowed to use NAT. This can be populated only if "LIST_OF_SECONDARY_IP_RANGES" is one of the values in source_ip_ranges_to_nat.

methods.name: setSecondaryIpRangeNames
methods.description: A list of the secondary ranges of the Subnetwork that are allowed to use NAT. This can be populated only if "LIST_OF_SECONDARY_IP_RANGES" is one of the values in source_ip_ranges_to_nat.

methods.name: getSourceIpRangesToNat
methods.description: Specify the options for NAT ranges in the Subnetwork. All options of a single value are valid except NAT_IP_RANGE_OPTION_UNSPECIFIED. The only valid option with multiple values is: ["PRIMARY_IP_RANGE", "LIST_OF_SECONDARY_IP_RANGES"] Default: [ALL_IP_RANGES]

methods.name: setSourceIpRangesToNat
methods.description: Specify the options for NAT ranges in the Subnetwork. All options of a single value are valid except NAT_IP_RANGE_OPTION_UNSPECIFIED. The only valid option with multiple values is: ["PRIMARY_IP_RANGE", "LIST_OF_SECONDARY_IP_RANGES"] Default: [ALL_IP_RANGES]
